name: @wyre-ai/connectwise-cpq-mcp-ui
description: Build-time-only package for the MCP Apps quote card. Kept out of the server package so ext-apps' v1 @modelcontextprotocol/sdk peer never enters the server dependency graph (the v2 migration contract bans the v1 SDK from the server lockfile). The built card is committed at ../src/generated/quote-card-html.ts, so the server build never needs this package.
